scope: 37 previously unexercised Field Spells; one significant official effect branch per Field, not exhaustive rulings.

reproducibility.method: Second clean output directory, same pinned sources and public build recipe

scenarios.description: Three distinct Noble Knight names unlock the End Phase deck-to-GY branch; the sent card has effect reason.

fixtureCards.name: Noble Knights of the Round Table

scenarios.description: A Normal Summon and real Monster Reborn Special Summon each add one Fire Fist Counter; the two-counter ignition pays both and shares its once-per-turn limit.

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Dragon

scenarios.description: Two opposing occupied Main Monster Zones leave three spaces; Summer places exactly three Season Counters and cannot repeat its ignition this turn.
Activation selects a Dinosaur, Sea Serpent and Wyrm, moving one to hand, one to banishment and one to GY; a Spellcaster revival is then unavailable.
The next own Draw Phase triggers Zexal Field before drawing and puts the shipped Shining Draw on top of the Deck.
Monster Reborn Special Summons a non-Token Normal Monster and the official Pere-Zenet field trigger draws one card.
Zelos searches Boss Rush, Special Summons B.E.S. Big Core from hand, boosts both stats by 500 and places its additional counter.
Recoil targets and destroys an own zero-ATK monster, then revives the independently targeted DARK Reptile and consumes its ignition limit.
After a generic Normal Summon consumes the regular allowance, Acropolis still permits Medius the Pure and rejects a third ordinary summon.
Home Stadium pays exactly 1000 LP, adds an Argostars card from face-up banishment to hand, and cannot repeat its recovery this turn.
With five own EARTH monsters, Full Bloom boosts each own monster by 1000 ATK while leaving an opposing EARTH monster unchanged.
Fandora counts two distinct Fur Hire names rather than three copies; its ignition searches from Deck before a different hand card is discarded by effect.
Formation revives a Beetrooper in turn three, loses LP equal to its original ATK and makes that monster unavailable as a Battle Phase attacker.
Galloping Gaia reveals an actual Gaia the Fierce Knight as cost without discarding it, searches a Level 5 Dragon and shares the once-per-turn limit between both search modes.
Fire Prison adds 300 DEF to Dragons on both sides, leaves a Spellcaster unchanged and prevents a normal Dragon from attacking in the real Battle Phase.
Future Visions targets a real Normal Summon, temporarily banishes it, leaves it absent through the opposing turn and returns it at its controller’s next Standby in face-up Attack Position.
An opposing Blue-Eyes destroys Danger!? Jackalope? by battle; Disorder then destroys that opposing Blue-Eyes by its own real trigger effect.
With an actual Level 7 LIGHT Dragon Synchro present, World of Spirits changes a Monster Reborn Special Summon from Attack to Defense by its mandatory trigger.
Perfect Sync searches a Dual Avatar monster, summons its Spirit Token and blocks an otherwise legal Link Spider from the Extra Deck for the rest of the turn.
When an opposing MST destroys Dogmatika Nation, its delayed trigger makes both players send one monster from their own Extra Deck to the GY by effect.
Void Expansion’s first own Standby trigger summons the official Infernoid Token with FIRE, Fiend, Level 1, ATK/DEF zero.
World Legacy’s Nightmare moves an existing Knightmare Phoenix from Main Monster Zone zero to another selected legal Main Monster Zone and cannot repeat.
Opposing MST destroys Origin; two distinct Reptile names in the GY, despite a duplicate, make the opponent mill exactly two cards by effect.
Palace counts distinct GY Attributes, searches an Elementsaber, then its scheduled next-turn Battle Phase skip persists after MST removes Palace.
HQ grants +500 ATK/DEF while the opponent controls a monster, then allows a Rescue-ACE Normal Summon after the regular summon is spent.
Walpurgis searches a genuine Witchcrafter from Deck, keeps the searched card and discards a different hand card by effect rather than as cost.
Mount Sylvania sends a hand Plant to GY as cost, chooses a real Sylvan spell from Deck and puts it on top with a native deck-top reveal.
With Umi present, Atlantis activates its graveyard ignition and replaces the Field; a real mentioning Daedalus then reduces all field and hand monster levels by one on both sides.

fixtureCards.name: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

scenarios.description: An actual opposing normal Draw Phase draw reveals a Tuner, draws two more through the Field trigger, then its owner loses 2000 LP and sends the Field to GY.

fixtureCards.name: Don't Slip, the Dogs of War

scenarios.description: Dark Hole destroys an own WIND monster; Shrine recruits a Level 2 WIND Effect Monster from Deck and the core marks that monster disabled.
A genuinely Set Waboku activates on a later turn and Labrynth Labyrinth resolves its delayed trigger to Special Summon a Fiend from hand.
A real Set Compulsory Evacuation Device returns an own Level 7 LIGHT Dragon from field to hand in its owner’s turn; Starry Knight Sky then draws exactly one.
While the owner controls a Normal Monster, an opposing Monster Reborn summons an Effect Monster and Tenyi’s delayed field trigger draws two cards.

fixtureCards.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear

scenarios.description: Babel’s official graveyard ignition sends an actual hand card to GY as cost and returns Babel to hand by effect, after being absent from the field.

An occupied Main Monster column prevents opposing MST from selecting its Set Spell/Trap; after MST destroys an uncovered card, Harpie’s Feather Duster destroys the Field but preserves the covered card.
Neo Space increases Elemental HERO Neos and a Fusion listing Neos by 500 ATK on either side, with a Blue-Eyes negative control unchanged.
Spell Wall grants only the owner’s monsters +300 ATK during the own turn, switches to +300 DEF during the opposing turn, and leaves the opponent’s monster unchanged.
